reference_dynamics.source: Shiu et al. 2024, Nature, doi 10.1038/s41586-024-07763-9, Methods
reference_dynamics.model: leaky integrate-and-fire with alpha synapses: dv/dt = (g - (v - V_rest))/T_mbr; dg/dt = -g/tau; g += w on a delayed presynaptic spike
reference_dynamics.weight: synapse count x sign x W_syn
reference_dynamics.input: forced spiking of the named input class at the stated rate (Shiu drove GRNs at 100 Hz)

nulls.shuffled_twin: degree-preserving rewire of G_traced: the postsynaptic endpoint column is permuted across all edges, which preserves every body's in-degree and out-degree and, because sign is a property of the presynaptic body, every sign; duplicate edges are summed; seeded
nulls.random_dynamics_twin: the real G_traced with the reference parameters replaced by draws: T_mbr U[5,80] ms, tau U[1,20] ms, T_dly U[0.5,5] ms, T_refractory U[1,5] ms, W_syn logU[0.05,1.5] mV, threshold gap U[3,20] mV, each jittered per neuron by logU[0.5,2]; signs permuted within their counts; seeded; v2: after the draw, the per-synapse scale is calibrated by binary search so the twin's population rate under a fixed probe (all ORN classes + LC4 + LPLC2 + T4a forced at 30 Hz for 300 ms after a 200 ms warmup) lies within [0.5, 2] x the reference model's rate under the same probe; the achieved probe rate is published per trial beside the score
nulls.pass_condition: v4: for each item and each sweep step, the real arm's count of trials showing the predicted direction (of 30) is compared with the fake's count (of 30) by a one-sided Fisher exact test; the item HOLDS against that fake at that step if p < 0.01. The paired-magnitude sign test (real minus fake per seed, predicted sign) is published beside it as the second output. Both fakes must be beaten for 'held'. The count-bar form is printed for readers: with the real arm at 30/30, the fake must show the direction in at most k of 30 where k is the largest count with Fisher p < 0.01. v5: beside every one-sided cell the two-sided Fisher p and the sign of the count difference are printed; a cell where the fake shows the direction MORE often than the real arm at two-sided p < 0.01 is labelled 'inverted' — a finding about the wiring (the real map suppresses a behaviour a fake produces freely), never a pass. 'held' is unchanged from v4: the real arm must beat both fakes one-sided at 0.01; per step for the random twin.
nulls.activity_note: v1's twin was mute (a scale bug) and then saturated (the bug fixed); a fake that is either silent or screaming makes 'fails' cheap. v2 requires the fake to be as alive as the model it is testing, and prints the rate.
nulls.rate_sweep: v3 (vish, c62628 on #4870): in addition to the v2 scalar calibration, the random-dynamics twin is calibrated by the same probe to each of five targets in turn — 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2 and 4 x the reference model's probe rate — within 25% of the target; ten paired trials per step on the same seeds; the achieved rate, scale and iteration count are written into every row; a verdict is printed per step beside the v2 scalar verdict, which remains the headline. An item that holds at every step is 'wiring plus physics' in the strong sense; one that holds only in a band is calibration-dependent and the band's edges are reported as the finding. v4: thirty paired trials per step; the step verdicts use the difference test above.

decoders.rate: mean spikes per second of the named class over the stimulus window, minus the same over the pre-stimulus window, averaged over trials
decoders.approach_index: rate(DNp09, forward-walking descending neurons; Bidaye et al. 2020) minus rate(MDN, moonwalker backward-walking descending neurons; Bidaye et al. 2014) — abstract-level citations, marked for verification
decoders.steer_asymmetry: rate(class, somaSide R) minus rate(class, somaSide L)
decoders.note: decoders are linear reads of named descending or motor classes; no learned policy

items.name: looming escape via the giant fibre

loom.rate_profile: 0 -> 150 Hz rising as 1/(t_collision - t) over the window

control_visual.rate_profile: same rising profile as loom, on non-looming visual projection classes of similar size

items.predicate: rate(DNp01 | loom) > rate(DNp01 | control_visual)  [recede is recorded, not scored: the reversed profile front-loads input]
items.literature_effect: GF necessary and sufficient for short-mode escape; short-mode fraction rises with looming speed; takeoff 215 +/- 42 ms after stimulus

items.name: optomotor turning
items.predicate: steer_asymmetry(HS | rot_a) and steer_asymmetry(HS | rot_b) have opposite signs; same for DNa02 (v4: both eyes driven, each with one direction subtype, so each side's HS receives a preferred and a null input across the two conditions — unspent, c63051)
items.literature_effect: T4a/T5a and T4b/T5b are tuned to opposite horizontal directions; unilateral HS activation turns the fly toward the stimulated side
items.v4_note: v1-v3 drove only the right eye; with a rate readout floored at zero the HS clause could not change sign and failed by construction. The rotation gives the clause a fair chance.

items.name: male courtship song pathway
items.predicate: rate(pC1 | female_taste) > rate(pC1 | none) AND rate(pIP10 | female_taste) > rate(pIP10 | none) AND rate(pC1 | cva) <= rate(pC1 | none)
items.literature_effect: P1 excited by female 7,11-HD via ppk25 -> vAB3; inhibited by cVA via Or67d/DA1; P1 and pIP10 trigger pulse song

limits: A wiring diagram carries no weights, dynamics, neuromodulation or plasticity; the reference dynamics are one published family, not the fly. Truncation profile of G_traced applies (ORN 0.669, ALPN 0.442, KC 0.843, DN 0.505 surviving weight per ompi/antoracle). Items keyed on glomeruli assume the standard receptor-to-glomerulus map. Decoder citations for DNp09/MDN are abstract-level.

ceiling_note.from: vish c66335 on the v4 rows (seal 6052)
ceiling_note.item_3_slope: random twin direction count 4, 6, 9, 13, 14 of 30 across 0.25x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 4x: about 2.5 per doubling. With the real arm at 30/30 the hold is lost at 0.01 when the fake reaches 24 of 30 (23 still holds, p = 0.0053): four more doublings at that slope.
ceiling_note.headroom: the 4x step ran at 41.2 to 66.0 spikes/s/neuron per trial (params.probe_rate in results/runs-v4.jsonl) against about 150 for a saturated network (c61797), so roughly 1.5 doublings of loudness remain physically reachable. The item 3 hold therefore spans the whole range a fake can occupy, which is the stronger sentence than held at five points.
ceiling_note.item_4_mirror: the quiet fake nearly matches (24/30 at 0.25x) and every louder step loses (11 to 19 of 30): item 4 is bounded from below, not above.
ceiling_note.rule: the sweep is not extended in v5; the note is the reading of the top step, printed beside it.
